title: A cleaner menu, details back in place
items: Vision and Venture share a floating animated hamburger. It disappears when the menu opens and returns when you close it.
Both menus use the same animated head and Lilita One lettering.
On mobile, Details opens from the bottom again. Its button sits below the circular plus button at the bottom right.
The plus button adds a node without the extra label.
Opening Venture’s menu no longer focuses Search or summons the keyboard. Tap Search when you want to use it.
